items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And I also used to go there and play... everybody that came through town came there afterwards, from Rahsaan Roland Kirk, Clifford Jordan, Sonny Rollins... I used to go down there on the weekends and just listen

ctx.x: Great story. I wonder what your father thought all of a sudden when he started hearing the saxophone coming out of your room eight to ten hours a day.

Well it was kind of funny because I can tell you, he didn’t hear it. But it was kind of interesting, he was conducting these jam sessions in Chicago. And I mean everybody that came through town came there afterwards, from Rahsaan Roland Kirk, Clifford Jordan, Sonny Rollins, you name it. They would work the places in Chicago and afterwards they’d go to wherever my Dad—And I used to go down there on the weekends and just listen and I got exposed to like all the players from out of the city, from New York and other…
